items.title: Dow Jones Soars 1,132 Points As Amazon, Tesla Rally, But Nvidia Dives; CPI Inflation Report Next
items.summary: Dow Jones futures were in focus after soaring 1,132 points ahead of the CPI inflation report. Amazon and Tesla rallied, but Nvidia dived.

items.title: Fervo Energy Co (FRVO) (Q3 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: First Geoblock Online, Google PPA ...
items.summary: Fervo Energy Co (FRVO) delivered 33 MW at Cape Station ahead of schedule, locked in a 15-year Google PPA and grew its contracted backlog to 1,054 MW, even as it posted a $43.7 million operating loss.

items.title: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal
items.summary: Six months before Nvidia's spy scandal erupted, Culper Research was already questioning Jensen Huang's unusually close relationship with a Chinese executive.
